items.title: Clarence Ford Interview, 1975-12-10
items.q: I was trying to play alto like Charlie Parker.

ctx.x: Were the bands different up in Detroit?

At the time, yes, very definitely. They played, they were leaning toward a more, I'd say, a rock swing type, show type band. See, at the time it was like Illinois Jacket, tenor players, played like that. And I was playing alto. I was trying to play alto like Charlie Parker. So the thing up there was a show like tenor, piano and drums, playing for a stage show. And a honking type tenor player, which I hadn't got into yet. So as a rule, the guys that were up there already doing it, I had to take a back seat to it…
Yeah, was that, when did you first start working with Dave Bartholomew?
